Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm grows more than 30,000 pounds of free produce a year and feeds 700 families weekly. The farm was facing a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ended. It had paused paid apprenticeships, reduced staff hours and started a campaign to raise $200,000 to stay afloat.
